channel.title: Wire — Engineering
channel.description: Engineering from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: How we halved DNS build delay and cut memory use by 85%
item.description: Zone setting changes used to rebuild entire DNS zones, even ones with tens of millions of records. Here is how we built a planner that picks the smallest safe build, cutting full builds by 40%, peak memory by 85%, and halving build delay. (1 source: cloudflare)

item.title: Google and Meta Open-source TorchTPU to Bring Native PyTorch Support to Google TPUs
item.description: TorchTPU is an open-source project developed by Google in collaboration with Meta that provides a native PyTorch backend for Google TPUs. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Article: Systemic Approach to Memory, Knowledge, and Context in Agentic AI Architectures
item.description: The article argues that reliable agentic AI architecture depends on a context engine that selects, injects, compresses, and expires information before it reaches the model. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Podcast: Educating an Architect: A Conversation with Luca Mezzalira
item.description: In this podcast, Michael Stiefel spoke to Luca Mezzalira about software architecture as a socio-technical discipline that balances technological design with an organization's social and managerial context. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Game Off 2026: The theme is SHIFT
item.description: GitHub’s annual month-long game jam is back for its 14th year! This November, make a game inspired by the theme SHIFT. Change gears, swap perspectives, bend reality, or just press a certain key. (1 source: githubblog)
